rationale: The CLI gains a forwarder from pulp ui to vellum ui when the checkout lacks tools/ui-build, and pulp import-design prints the vellum import spelling when the importer binary is not built. Both run only on those absent-tool paths; builds with the importer and ui-build tool behave as before. No design-import, Chromium, rendering or packaging authority moves: the forwarders include no view, canvas, render or design-import headers and execute nothing for import-design.
